title: The Supplier Evidence Maturity Model (SEMM)
custom_excerpt: The published framework behind every Villanova ESG review: five maturity levels that describe how far a supplier's evidence is from being decision-ready for a European buyer.
meta_title: Supplier Evidence Maturity Model (SEMM) | Villanova ESG
meta_description: SEMM: the published framework (with DOI) that grades supplier evidence from level 0 to 4 — the backbone of Villanova ESG diagnostics and buyer-side supplier assessments.
html:
Every Villanova ESG engagement is graded against one published yardstick: the Supplier Evidence Maturity Model (SEMM). It answers the question that decides contracts in EU–Brazil supply chains: how far is this supplier's evidence from being usable in a European buyer's decision?

This is advisory work. It is not an audit, certification, legal opinion, emissions verification or a guarantee of buyer acceptance — and every deliverable states that boundary.

Why a maturity model — and not a checklist

Checklists ask whether a document exists. Buyers, banks and regulators ask something harder: whether the record would survive their review — is it current, scoped, owned, consistent with the operation, and readable by someone who was not in the room? SEMM grades that distance, so that a supplier, a buyer and an advisor can talk about the same file with the same words.

The five levels

Level 0 — Absent

The evidence the request requires does not exist, or cannot be located. The answer to the buyer would be silence.

Level 1 — Fragmented

Records exist but are scattered across inboxes, spreadsheets and suppliers of suppliers. Reconstructing an answer is a project every time.

Level 2 — Organised

Records are collected and filed, but not mapped to the questions buyers actually ask — completeness without readability.

Level 3 — Decision-ready

Each likely buyer question is linked to the record that answers it, with owner, date, scope and source. A CFO can defend the file in one meeting.

Level 4 — Continuously managed

The file is maintained as a living asset: expiry control, update calendar, and a register of what changed and why. The next request is an export, not an emergency.

The authoritative definition of the model — dimensions, grading criteria and worked examples — is in the published technical reports, deposited with persistent identifiers (DOIs) on Zenodo. Deposit is a public record, not peer review, and we say so.

How SEMM is used

  1. Supplier-side diagnostics. A company that sells to Europe is graded level by level, producing a gap register and a prioritised action plan — the core of the Supplier Evidence File Assessment.
  2. Buyer-side supplier assessments. A European buyer applies the same yardstick across its Brazilian supplier base — comparable grades instead of incomparable questionnaire answers. See how we work with European buyers.
  3. Continuous management. For files under ongoing pressure, the model defines what "maintained" means month to month — the basis of Continuous Evidence Management.

What SEMM is not

Is not: a certification, a label, a score to publish in marketing, or a guarantee that any buyer will accept the file. It is a working instrument for making evidence decision-ready — the decision itself always belongs to the buyer, the bank or the regulator.

title: For European buyers with suppliers in Brazil
custom_excerpt: CSDDD, CSRD and CBAM make your suppliers' evidence your problem. We assess Brazilian suppliers at origin — in Portuguese, against one published yardstick — and return files your committees can actually use.
meta_title: For European buyers — Brazilian supplier evidence | Villanova ESG
meta_description: European companies with suppliers in Brazil: supplier evidence assessments at origin, in Portuguese, graded against the published SEMM framework. Advisory, not certification.
html:
If your company buys from Brazil, European rules have quietly moved your suppliers' paperwork onto your desk: due-diligence duties under CSDDD, value-chain reporting under CSRD, embedded-emissions data under CBAM, traceability under EUDR. The questionnaires you send come back — in Portuguese, late, incomparable, and impossible to grade from Munich or Milan.

Villanova ESG works the other end of that problem: at origin. We review your Brazilian suppliers' evidence where it lives — in the language it was written, against the operation it describes — and return it in the structure your procurement, compliance and audit teams can actually use.

This is advisory work. It is not an audit, certification, legal opinion, emissions verification or a guarantee of buyer acceptance — and every deliverable states that boundary.

What we do for buyers

Per-supplier evidence assessment

Each supplier graded against the published SEMM framework: what exists, what is missing, what would not survive your review — with owner, date, scope and source per record. Comparable across the whole supplier base.

Is not: an audit, an EcoVadis-style self-declared score, or a site certification.

Pilot cohort

Start with a small set of critical suppliers — enough to test the method against your framework before extending it across the base. Scope, cohort and calendar defined in the scoping conversation.

Supplier development path

Assessment without a path breeds resentment. Each graded supplier receives a prioritised gap register in Portuguese — so your supply base improves instead of churning.

Why at origin — and why us

  1. Language and ground truth. Brazilian evidence is written in Portuguese, referenced to Brazilian instruments (MTR, CDF, licences). Reading it accurately is the work — translation alone loses the scope and the caveats.
  2. A published yardstick. The methodology is public, citable and deposited with DOIs — your committees can read exactly how a grade was produced. No black-box scoring.
  3. Operational lineage. The founder also leads Ecobraz, a documented Brazilian reverse-logistics operation serving corporate clients since 2011. Distinct organisations, declared relationship: it means the person grading a chain-of-custody record has actually run one.
  4. Boundary discipline. Deliverables state what each record proves and what it does not. If a statement cannot be verified, it is not written.

Where this fits your obligations

The assessments are designed to feed the processes the rules require of you — risk analysis and monitoring under CSDDD, value-chain information for CSRD, supplier data organisation for CBAM and EUDR — without pretending to replace them. Your legal duty, your assurance provider and your filings remain yours; our work makes the underlying supplier evidence usable inside them.

What buyers ask us first

Can you certify our suppliers? No — and be wary of anyone who says yes. We produce advisory assessments with a published methodology. Certification is a different, accredited activity.

Do you work in English? Deliverables are in English (or Italian on request); the origin work happens in Portuguese — that is the point.

What does it cost? Engagements are scoped case by case — cohort size, depth and calendar drive the work. The scoping conversation ends with a written proposal.

title: Continuous Evidence Management
custom_excerpt: The retainer for files under permanent pressure: expiry control, update calendar, questionnaire support and a maintained evidence structure — so the next request is an export, not an emergency.
meta_description: Ongoing management of supplier evidence files: expiry control, update calendar, buyer questionnaire support. SEMM level 4 as a service — advisory, not certification.
html:
An evidence file organised once starts decaying the day it is delivered: licences expire, suppliers change, a new questionnaire arrives with different questions. Continuous Evidence Management is the retainer that keeps a file at SEMM level 4 — continuously managed — instead of letting every buyer request restart the archaeology.

This is advisory work. It is not an audit, certification, legal opinion, emissions verification or a guarantee of buyer acceptance — and every deliverable states that boundary.

What is managed, month to month

Expiry and validity control

Every dated record tracked; renewals flagged before they become gaps a buyer finds first.

Update calendar

A maintained register of what changed in the operation and which records must follow — with owners and dates.

Request support

When a questionnaire, clause or data request arrives, the answer is assembled from the maintained structure — reviewed, scoped, on the buyer's deadline.

Periodic file review

The file re-graded against SEMM at agreed intervals, so improvement (or decay) is visible and assignable.

Engagement shapes

Retainers are annual and come in three shapes — an essential cadence for stable files, a standard cadence for files under regular buyer pressure, and a defined-SLA shape for operations with contractual response deadlines. Which shape fits, and what it costs, is defined case by case in the scoping conversation — the work is sized to the file, not to a menu.

Is not: an outsourced compliance department, a legal watch service, an audit, or a guarantee that any request will be accepted. It keeps your evidence decision-ready; decisions remain the buyer's.

Where it starts

Continuous management presupposes a file worth maintaining. Most clients arrive through the Supplier Evidence File Assessment, which builds the structure and the gap register that this retainer then keeps alive.

title: Scope 3 Brazil Programme
custom_excerpt: For European companies that need their Brazilian chain documented: a structured programme combining Villanova ESG advisory with declared operational execution in Brazil by Ecobraz — distinct organisations, stated governance.
meta_description: A structured programme for documenting the Brazilian end of European value chains: advisory by Villanova ESG, operational execution by Ecobraz — a declared relationship with stated governance. No credits, no offsets.
html:
European value-chain obligations end in places like São Paulo: the supplier's warehouse, the disposal of IT assets, the documentation of what actually happened to materials. The Scope 3 Brazil Programme exists for companies that need that Brazilian end documented at source — not estimated from a desk in Europe.

This is advisory work. It is not an audit, certification, legal opinion, emissions verification or a guarantee of buyer acceptance — and every deliverable states that boundary.

How the programme is built

  1. Setup. Scope definition, mapping of the Brazilian chain segment, evidence architecture and baseline file — graded against the SEMM framework.
  2. Twelve months of accompaniment. The evidence file maintained as the operation runs: records collected at origin, gaps registered and closed, monthly visibility.
  3. Annual programme report. What was executed, what is documented, what each record proves and what it does not — written to be read by your committees and, when you choose, by your independent assurance provider.

Who does what — a declared relationship

Villanova ESG advises and documents. Ecobraz operates. Ecobraz is a Brazilian reverse-logistics organisation (collection, sorting, documented disposal of electronics, serving corporate clients since 2011), founded and led by the same principal as Villanova ESG. We state this relationship rather than hide it, and the engagement documents specify which entity performs each activity, under which responsibility. Operational execution in Brazil — collections, chain-of-custody records, disposal documentation — is contracted with and performed by Ecobraz; advisory review and buyer-readable documentation are performed by Villanova ESG.

Territorial impact component: clients that want a social dimension in Brazil can contract Adote um Bairro (a neighbourhood collection and digital-inclusion programme listed as a good practice on the ECESP — listing is visibility, not endorsement) directly with Ecobraz, in Brazilian reais, as a separate engagement.

What the programme does not sell

Is not: carbon credits, offsets or neutrality claims — the programme documents operations; it does not sell compensation. It is not an audit or certification, and no emission figure is reported without a defined methodology, sources and base year stated on the deliverable. It does not replace your inventory, your assurance provider or your legal obligations.

What it costs

Programmes are scoped case by case — chain segment, sites, cadence and reporting depth drive the work. The scoping conversation ends with a written proposal covering both entities' roles.

title: Villanova ESG — per le aziende italiane
custom_excerpt: Consulenza sull'evidenza dei fornitori tra Unione Europea e Brasile: revisione dei dossier alla fonte, in portoghese, restituita in una struttura leggibile dai vostri comitati. Advisory, non certificazione.
meta_title: Villanova ESG — evidenza dei fornitori Brasile–UE | per aziende italiane
meta_description: Per aziende italiane con fornitori o filiali in Brasile: valutazione dell'evidenza dei fornitori alla fonte, secondo un framework pubblicato (SEMM). Advisory, non certificazione.
html:
Se la vostra azienda acquista dal Brasile — o vi opera con una filiale — le regole europee hanno spostato sul vostro tavolo la documentazione dei fornitori: due diligence (CSDDD), rendicontazione di filiera (CSRD), dati sulle emissioni incorporate (CBAM), tracciabilità (EUDR). I questionari tornano in portoghese, in ritardo e non confrontabili.

Villanova ESG lavora alla fonte: esaminiamo l'evidenza dei fornitori brasiliani dove nasce — nella lingua in cui è scritta, rispetto all'operazione che descrive — e la restituiamo nella struttura che i vostri team di procurement, compliance e audit possono davvero usare.

È un lavoro di advisory. Non è un audit, una certificazione, un parere legale o una garanzia di accettazione da parte dell'acquirente — e ogni deliverable dichiara questo confine.

Cosa facciamo

Valutazione per fornitore

Ogni fornitore valutato secondo il framework pubblicato SEMM (livelli 0–4): cosa esiste, cosa manca, cosa non supererebbe la vostra revisione.

Gestione continuativa

Il dossier mantenuto vivo: scadenze, aggiornamenti, supporto alle richieste dei buyer. Continuous Evidence Management →

Programma Scope 3 Brasile

Il tratto brasiliano della vostra filiera documentato alla fonte, con esecuzione operativa dichiarata da parte di Ecobraz — organizzazioni distinte, relazione dichiarata. Dettagli →

Perché Villanova ESG

Metodologia pubblicata e citabile (rapporti tecnici con DOI su Zenodo — deposito pubblico, non peer review, e lo diciamo). Lignaggio operativo reale in Brasile dal 2011. Disciplina dei confini: ogni documento dichiara cosa prova e cosa non prova. La preparazione al Digital Product Passport è trattata come preparazione documentale — mai come garanzia di conformità.

Prenota una conversazione di scoping (30 minuti)

Lavoriamo in italiano, inglese e portoghese. Il lavoro alla fonte avviene in portoghese — è esattamente il punto.
